feeding_claim.verbatim: Grass-fed and grass-finished right here in Michigan.

resold_note: Also sells beef from partner graziers (including Apsey Farms), chicken from Joe's Farm, pork from Flying W Ranch, eggs from Hehlden Farms and Alaskan seafood from Net to Table.
notes: Scout 2026-11-27: read rebelpastures.com About, Our Story, Rebel Farmers, Contact Us, Shipping, and the grassfed lamb, grass-fed beef and bison collection pages, all through WebFetch summaries, so the quote came from a summary; Verifier: recheck exact wording (quote is about the lamb, which the site says is raised on its own ground). Doubts: this is largely an online brand that resells partner-farm meat. Lamb is raised on its own land in West Michigan; beef is described as our herd plus a trusted circle of graziers, so beef is partly resold. Bison page says raised in Michigan but does not say by whom, so bison left out of species. Town: no address on the site; Rebel Farmers page calls Rockford its hometown and lamb page says West Michigan, so Rockford is a best guess. Ships to the lower 48 states (recorded as nationwide); no pickup, local delivery or markets. No bulk animal shares, only bundles. Veteran owned. Apsey Farms (also a candidate) is named as a beef partner.
